mapper.sql: SELECT program_id AS id, region, program_name AS title, COALESCE(summary, description) AS summary, COALESCE(agency_name, '') AS agency, COALESCE(benefit_summary, '') AS benefit, period_text AS period, apply_url AS applyUrl, target_species AS targetSpecies, start_date AS startDate, end_date AS endDate FROM local_support_program
mapper.select: WHERE is_active = 1 AND (start_date IS NULL OR start_date <= CURDATE()) AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= CURDATE()) ORDER BY region, program_name

SELECT program_condition_id AS id, condition_type AS conditionType, operator, condition_value AS conditionValue, title, description, is_required AS isRequired FROM local_support_program_condition WHERE program_id = #{programId} ORDER BY display_order, created_at
SELECT * FROM support_program_interest WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND program_id = #{programId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO support_program_interest (member_id, program_id, pet_id, status) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{programId}, #{petId}, #{status}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pet_id = VALUES(pet_id), status = VALUES(status), updated_at = NOW()
